name: Energy Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public energy data.

entries.title: EPA Emissions & Generation Resource Integrated Database (eGRID)
entries.description: EPA's comprehensive source of environmental characteristics of almost all U.S. electric power generation — emissions, emission rates, net generation, and resource mix — at plant, state, and grid-subregion level.

coverage.spatial: United States (plant, state, balancing authority, eGRID subregion)
coverage.temporal: data years back to 1996 (latest edition eGRID2023)

entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (page "Last updated on September 21, 2026"). The detailed-data page (https://www.epa.gov/egrid/detailed-data) lists eGRID2023, released 1/15/2025 with revisions on 1/17/2025 and 6/12/2025, as an xlsx download with a PDF technical guide. Editions now come out roughly yearly but not on a fixed schedule, so cadence is irregular. The 1996 start year comes from EPA's historical editions and should be confirmed by a steward.

entries.title: World Bank Energy & Mining Indicators (World Development Indicators)
entries.description: Cross-country energy indicators — electricity access, consumption, renewable share, and energy imports — compiled by the World Bank as part of its World Development Indicators database.
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). IEA and IRENA — the other obvious international energy-statistics bodies — both returned bot-challenge pages (Cloudflare / Azure WAF) on direct fetch this session, the same class of block tracked for BLS/SEC in almanac-template#2. Worth a headless-verified follow-up entry once that fix lands, rather than skipping them. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
